title_zh: 医疗剧：手术台旁的生死时速
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (11/20): Racing Against Death at the Operating Table
note_en: 后 (hòu, "after") goes at the end of a clause to turn a whole event into a time phrase: 手术结束后 "after the surgery ended." English puts "after" first, before the event; Chinese states the event first and tacks 后 on behind it, and the time phrase then comes before the main clause: 手术结束后，医生疲惫地走出手术室. The same goes for 前 "before" and 时 "when."
